task_spec: PR: add reserve_seat() which refuses to oversell by checking remaining inventory before decrementing.

bugs.description: reserve_seat reads remaining, checks it, THEN decrements as separate steps with no lock / atomic conditional update. Two concurrent requests for the last seat both read remaining=1, both pass the check, both decrement -> oversell (remaining goes negative). Correct on any single sequential read; wrong only under interleaving. Fix: atomic conditional decrement (e.g. UPDATE ... WHERE remaining >= qty) or a per-event lock. Not visible in a single-threaded reading of the function.

provenance.note: TOCTOU: the check-then-act gap is only a bug under concurrent interleaving; a single-threaded read of the function looks correct. Requires imagining the race.
